body:
## Public-source finding

Reviewed Router 1.18.2 at public commit `d7f602b8c4a920c61ceee1c8017b618cb401126e`. This report is based exclusively on public source and tests; it contains no operator incident, private log excerpts, credentials, request payloads, identifiers or screenshots.

In automatic routing, a known model whose provider credential is rejected becomes a local model-not-found error:

- [`src/proxy_dispatch.rs:233`](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/d7f602b8c4a920c61ceee1c8017b618cb401126e/src/proxy_dispatch.rs#L233) and `src/refresh_evidence.rs` record upstream credential rejection.
- [`src/model_routing_snapshot.rs:539`](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/d7f602b8c4a920c61ceee1c8017b618cb401126e/src/model_routing_snapshot.rs#L539) already knows the model's provider. If no validated subscription is available, it returns `ModelRouteError::NotFound` with a message saying the model has no healthy provider credential.
- [`src/model_routing.rs:61`](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/d7f602b8c4a920c61ceee1c8017b618cb401126e/src/model_routing.rs#L61) maps this to HTTP 404 / Anthropic `not_found_error`. An unavailable provider account and an actually unknown model therefore share the error classification.
- [`src/request_log.rs:922`](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/d7f602b8c4a920c61ceee1c8017b618cb401126e/src/request_log.rs#L922) captures `client_response_body` only when upstream was seen or the response succeeded. A locally generated non-success response loses its error body, even when the client consumes it.
- [`tests/denied_request_logging_test.rs:243`](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/d7f602b8c4a920c61ceee1c8017b618cb401126e/tests/denied_request_logging_test.rs#L243) consumes the response and explicitly asserts only `client_request` and `client_response` phases.

This classification can direct a client toward changing a valid model rather than addressing provider-account availability. The missing local response body also prevents the request log from preserving the explanatory message that Router generated.

## Expected behavior

1. Distinguish an unknown model from a known model with unusable provider credentials, and distinguish both from an unauthorized Router client token. Preserve a safe actionable provider/account reason through local routing failure presentation.
2. Preserve the user's requested model. A healthy account in an allowed pool may be selected according to existing routing rules; do not silently substitute a different model to hide a credential failure.
3. Record safe local error response bodies or an equivalent structured error classification, retaining credential redaction and the existing restrictions on sensitive fields.
4. Keep the client catalog's availability state consistent with routing admission. A changed credential must clear obsolete rejection evidence according to the existing refresh contract.
5. Update the early-denial logging tests and the documentation promising complete request exchanges. Keep these diagnostics in file logs as requested in #717 and #718.

## Verification

Add an internal hermetic integration fixture that seeds a valid catalog and uses a local fake upstream with synthetic credential files. The public repository already has such building blocks in `src/model_routing_evidence_tests.rs`.

- First request: fake upstream rejects the account with 401; verify the existing rejection evidence.
- Subsequent request for the same known model: assert an account/authentication availability failure rather than unknown-model classification, and a logged local error body/classification.
- Cover another known model on the same rejected account, a healthy replacement account, updated credentials, a genuinely unknown model, and an unauthorized Router client token.
- Consume response bodies in the logging assertions. No real vendor account or macOS Keychain should be accessed.

Scope limitation: the automatic routing path is the affected code. Explicit `UPSTREAM_PROVIDER=anthropic` bypasses this automatic selection. A complete published-binary fake-upstream reproduction was not run: the Claude catalog endpoint is not configurable through `UPSTREAM_BASE_URL`, and startup validates the catalog before listening. This is a source-level finding supported by the existing public tests, not a claim of a fresh live-account reproduction on 1.18.2.
title: Distinguish rejected provider credentials from model-not-found and log local error responses
